name: robosteam-compile-service
description: Local dev server for the RoboSTEAM simulator: serves the site and compiles Arduino sketches with arduino-cli at /api/compile.

scripts.vendor: esbuild node_modules/avr8js/dist/esm/index.js --bundle --format=esm --minify --legal-comments=inline --banner:js="/* avr8js (MIT, https://github.com/wokwi/avr8js), bundled by compile-service: npm run vendor */" --outfile=../js/vendor/avr8js.js
